title: Maddie Blaustein
summary:
Maddie Blaustein, also known as Kendra Bancroft and Adam Seth Blaustein, was an American voice actress, comic book writer and transgender rights activists who played the role of Rassimov in Season 1 of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, as well as the role of Meowth in the Pokémon anime series.

Blaustein was born in Long Island, New York on the 9th of October 1960. She was born intersex but assigned male at birth and transitioned to female. On December 11th 2008, she died of an untreated stomach virus in Jersey City, New Jersey, and later buried at the Congregation B'nai Israel Cemetery. Her work in Season 1 of Huntik was thus released posthumously, and Marc Diraison took over the role of Rassimov in Season 2.

'''Maddie Blaustein''', also known as '''Kendra Bancroft''' and '''Adam Seth Blaustein''', was an American voice actress, comic book writer and transgender rights activists who played the role of [[Rassimov]] in [[Season 1]] of ''[[Huntik: Secrets & Seekers]]'', as well as the role of Meowth in the ''Pokémon'' anime series. 

Blaustein was born in Long Island, New York on the 9th of October 1960. She was born intersex but assigned male at birth and transitioned to female. On December 11th 2008, she died of an untreated stomach virus in Jersey City, New Jersey, and later buried at the Congregation B'nai Israel Cemetery. Her work in [[Season 1]] of ''Huntik'' was thus released posthumously, and [[Marc Diraison]] took over the role of Rassimov in Season 2.
